info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Loan Application Offer-spec
info.description: The Loan Application Offer Submission API facilitates the creation of offers for loan applications. By submitting a loan application identifier, users can generate tailored loan offers, enhancing customer engagement and decision-making. This API is primarily aimed at financial institutions and loan processing platforms looking to streamline their lending processes. Typical consumer use cases include banks, credit unions, and loan service providers that require efficient offer generation based on specific application criteria.

post.summary: Create a New Loan Application Offer
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new offer for a specific loan application identified by its unique resource number. Ensure all required details are provided for a successful offer creation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new offer for a specific loan application identified by RES-100045. It contains all the necessary details that need to be provided to process the offer successfully.
